intro: In Stormwind, Jennea Cannon guides new mages through their first studies. From the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter, she teaches caution and self-control, and investigates disturbances in local arcane energies.

p: At the top of the Wizard's Sanctum's spiral walkway, Jennea Cannon guides those who come to Stormwind to study the arcane. She teaches more than spells, insisting that students learn caution and self-control. Even those who do not study magic hear her warning: without training, magic can burn its wielder.

Jennea sends promising apprentices beyond the city walls to test what they have learned. At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, they study how natural water sources meet arcane resonance. As they advance, she sends them to investigate disturbances at the Blue Recluse or gather volatile reagents for their first true wizard's implements.

When an apprentice outgrows Jennea's lessons, she points the way to greater masters. Those who show true potential may continue up the Sanctum's hierarchy with High Sorcerer Andromath, or travel beyond the kingdom to practitioners such as Tabetha, deep in the Dustwallow Marsh.
